metadata.name: queue_claim
metadata.description: Tokenized redemption-queue claims: attested request -> claim position token, issuer consent flags, sell in an auction session or pledge into the liquidity facility, window fills swept facility-first (SRS 08 §4.4, QC-P1..P5).

instructions.name: attest
docs: QC-P1/P2: the attester confirms the request (queue rank + expected
fill schedule). Mints the claim position token to the holder and
freezes it: non-transferable until issuer consent.

instructions.name: cancel
docs: Cancel before any fill (QC-P2 Cancelled): the holder returns the
claim token (burned) and gets the NPCS back.

instructions.name: collect
docs: QC-P4: the holder of an unpledged claim token takes the proceeds.

accounts.name: claim
docs: The caller's claim token account: holds the claim.

instructions.name: discharge
docs: Clear a pledge whose advance the rails have closed (repaid in full
by any path). Permissionless.

instructions.name: init_queue
docs: One queue per asset. The signer is the issuer authority (consent
flags, fills, freezes); `attester` attests requests (QC-P1).

accounts.name: program
docs: This program, to locate its ProgramData. The first caller of init_queue would own the queue and name its attester: only the upgrade authority may create one.

instructions.name: init_queue_config
docs: QC-P1 / QC-P3 per-queue settings, in their own PDA so the live
queue accounts keep their layout. Issuer authority only.

instructions.name: pledge
docs: QC-P4: pledge the claim into a liquidity-facility for `amount` USDC.
Remaining accounts: the facility `PledgeAndAdvance` list followed
by its rails `AdvanceFunds` list.

instructions.name: quote_pv
docs: QC-P3: the claim's model value — `credit_math::pv_of_claim` over the
unfilled part of the attested schedule, each expected fill priced at
the underlying asset's `MARK_PROTECTIVE`, discounted per period.
Evented for the nav-publisher, which publishes it to the claim feed.

accounts.name: asset_feed
docs: The underlying asset's mark-engine feed.

instructions.name: quote_pv_model
docs: QC-P3 (doc 06 §5): the claim's model value from the published
[`FillModel`] — `E[fill_t]` from gate %, queue depth and fill
history over the request's outstanding quantity, each priced at
the asset's `MARK_PROTECTIVE` and discounted per period by
`credit_math::pv_of_claim`. Without a published model it fails
[`QcError::NoFillModel`]: use `quote_pv` (the attested schedule).

accounts.name: asset_feed
docs: The underlying asset's mark-engine feed.

instructions.name: record_fill
docs: QC-P4: a real window execution. The issuer pays `fill_qty × price`
USDC into the claim's cash vault (rounded up: the issuer initiates)
and receives the redeemed NPCS from the request vault. `price` must
sit within [`FILL_PRICE_TOLERANCE_BPS`] of the asset feed's
redemption NAV (doc 09: redemption at published NAV). A
treasury-backed asset (its mint authority is npcs-treasury's signer)
redeems through `record_fill_redeem` instead.

accounts.name: asset_feed
docs: The asset's mark-engine feed: the fill price is bound to its NAV.

instructions.name: record_fill_redeem
docs: QC-P4 / doc 09 Path 5 + 8 for a treasury-backed asset (NPCS): the
window's `fill_qty` burns out of the request vault through
npcs-treasury `redeem_from`, which pays `fill_qty × NAV_effective`
USDC straight into the claim's cash vault. No issuer-supplied price:
the treasury reads the asset feed. The queue authority signs as the
treasury's issuer authority (they must be the same key).

accounts.name: authority
docs: Issuer: the queue authority and the treasury authority.

instructions.name: request_redemption
docs: QC-P1: the holder submits a redemption request; `qty` NPCS move
into the request vault until filled or cancelled.

accounts.name: queue_config
docs: = no config (SAS off). Always passed, so it cannot be skipped.

accounts.name: attestation
docs: checked in the handler when the config requires it.

instructions.name: set_fill_model
docs: QC-P3: publish this window's PV model inputs (the issuer authority
or the queue's attester, the transfer-agent bridge).

accounts.name: publisher
docs: The issuer authority or the queue's attester.

instructions.name: set_flags
docs: QC-P2: issuer consent, set independently. Either flag thaws the
original holder account (the token must be able to move into an
auction escrow or the facility's custody); neither re-freezes it.

instructions.name: set_queue_config
docs: Change the QC-P1 settings (issuer authority).

instructions.name: set_state
docs: QC-P2 Frozen (NAV suspended / fund gates fully) and back, or
Restructured (redemptions suspended indefinitely). Issuer only.

instructions.name: sweep_pledged
docs: QC-P4: a pledged claim's proceeds go through rails
`sweep_proceeds`: facility repayment first, the rest to the
borrower's registered destination. Permissionless. Remaining
accounts: the rails `SweepProceeds` list.

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: amount must be positive

errors.name: NotAttester
errors.msg: signer is not the queue's attester

errors.name: NotIssuer
errors.msg: signer is not the issuer authority

errors.name: NotHolder
errors.msg: signer is not the request holder

errors.name: MintMismatch
errors.msg: mint or vault does not match the queue/request

errors.name: WrongState
errors.msg: request is not in a state that allows this

errors.name: BadSchedule
errors.msg: schedule empty, too long, or above the request qty

errors.name: NotPledgeable
errors.msg: issuer has not consented to pledging

errors.name: AlreadyPledged
errors.msg: claim already pledged

errors.name: Pledged
errors.msg: claim is pledged: proceeds go through sweep_pledged

errors.name: NotPledged
errors.msg: claim is not pledged

errors.name: OverFill
errors.msg: fill exceeds the unfilled quantity

errors.name: ClaimNotHeld
errors.msg: caller does not hold the claim token

errors.name: FacilityAccounts
errors.msg: facility / rails accounts do not match

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: arithmetic overflow

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: Only the program's upgrade authority may do this

errors.name: FillPriceOffNav
errors.msg: fill price deviates from the asset feed's redemption NAV

errors.name: UseTreasuryRedeem
errors.msg: treasury-backed asset: redeem the fill through record_fill_redeem

errors.name: BadRedemptionAttestation
errors.msg: missing or invalid SAS redemption_request attestation (QC-P1)

errors.name: BadQueueConfig
errors.msg: queue config: SAS required without credential, schema and attester

errors.name: BadFillModel
errors.msg: fill model out of bounds

errors.name: NoFillModel
errors.msg: no fill model published: quote with quote_pv

errors.name: MarkUnavailable
errors.msg: no redemption NAV: the asset mark is Stale, Suspended or unpublished

types.name: ClaimState
docs: QC-P2 states (doc 06 §5). Transferable / Pledgeable are the
independent consent flags on the request.

fields.name: print_source
docs: auction-engine's print PDA (the only `record_print` signer).

fields.name: nav_pico
docs: Latest official NAV at [`NAV_SCALE`] (0 = never published).

fields.name: effective_ts
docs: When the NAV was written on-chain; ages are measured from here.

fields.name: last_drill
docs: The latest NAV came from `publish_drill_nav`.

fields.name: last_state
docs: Last evented state (transitions are evented once).

fields.name: implied_pico
docs: Implied NAV from the latest eligible print (0 = none).

fields.name: warn_after
docs: Age at which a Fresh mark becomes Warned.

fields.name: stale_after
docs: Age at which the mark becomes Stale.

fields.name: warned_haircut_bps
docs: Haircut applied while Warned (≤ `MAX_WARNED_HAIRCUT_BPS`).

fields.name: stale_haircut_bps
docs: Haircut applied while Stale or Suspended (≤ `MAX_STALE_HAIRCUT_BPS`).

fields.name: band_bps
docs: BANDED width, bps of price.

fields.name: min_print_volume
docs: Minimum print volume (base units) to enter the implied curve.

fields.name: min_print_investors
docs: Minimum distinct investor_ids on a print (G2).

fields.name: outlier_band_bps
docs: Maximum |print − NAV| / NAV for an eligible print.

fields.name: drills_enabled
docs: Devnet only: allow `publish_drill_nav` (AC-9 drill). Fixed at
`initialize_feed`.

fields.name: gate_bps
docs: Share of the fund redeemable per window (bps of `fund_supply`).

fields.name: fund_supply
docs: Units outstanding in the fund (base units).

fields.name: queue_depth
docs: Units requested across the whole queue, this request included.

fields.name: fill_history_bps
docs: Historical fill ratio per window (bps; 0 = no history yet).

fields.name: periods
docs: Windows valued (1..=`MAX_MODEL_PERIODS`).

types.name: MarkState
docs: ME-P2 mark states. `Suspended` is set only by `suspend`. `Frozen`
(appended, #202) is age > 3× cadence (06 §4).

types.name: PrintPolicy
docs: ME-P6 print policy classes.

types.name: QueueConfig
docs: Per-queue settings added after the queues went live (#202): its own
PDA `["queue_cfg", queue]`, so `Queue` keeps its layout. No account =
every default (SAS off, no PV model).

fields.name: fill_model
docs: QC-P3 model inputs (`set_fill_model`).

fields.name: model_ts
docs: When the model was published (0 = never).

fields.name: require_sas
docs: QC-P1: requests need a SAS `redemption_request` attestation.

fields.name: sas_attester
docs: The SAS signer of request attestations (issuer / TA bridge).

fields.name: holder_claim
docs: The token account the claim was minted to.

types.name: ScheduledFill
docs: One attested expected fill: `qty` base units in window `period`
(0 = next window).
